question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Diminish
solution:
The correct answer is **'Extend'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Diminish** is a verb which means to make or become less. 
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Abate** - (of something unpleasant or severe) become less intense or widespread.
 
• **Recede** - go or move back or further away from a previous position.
 
• **Curtail** - reduce in extent or quantity; impose a restriction on.
 
• **Extend **- cause to cover a wider area; make larger.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **extend** is the correct antonym for the word **diminish**.
